name: review-toolkit
description: Parallel multi-agent code review: review-lead orchestration skill with its Workflow-based review fan-out, reviewer-baseline shared protocol, generic reviewer agents (scope-completeness, security, performance, maintainability, complexity, db, pipeline, a11y, test-coverage, unit-test-mutation, plan, spec). On the pipeline path the review panel defaults to scope-completeness; the rest are opt-in. Per-repo reviewer registry deltas and model-tier overrides come from .claude/second-shift.config.json; domain rules from documented extension files.
